title: Geometric Alignment without Functional Equivalence: A Layer-wise Analysis of the Speech-Text Modality Gap
abstract: arXiv:2603.01502v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: End-to-end speech large language models (LLMs) often answer the same question less accurately from speech than from text, even when the spoken content matches the text prompt. Existing analyses study this modality gap through the geometry of representations and measure how closely speech representations align with text. Geometric alignment gives the gap a measurable form, but it does not show whether the model uses aligned representations in the same way. This work connects representation geometry with answer formation and asks whether geometric alignment implies functional equivalence. We compare cross-layer Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) with layer-wise answer margins for four open-weight speech LLMs on SpeechMMLU and VoiceBench BBH. In Qwen2.5-Omni and MiniCPM-o, speech and text representations align in middle layers while their late-layer answer margins still differ, so mid-layer alignment does not imply functional equivalence.

translated_title: 无功能等价的几何对齐：语音-文本模态差距的逐层分析
translated_abstract: 端到端语音大语言模型（LLM）在从语音回答同一问题时，其准确率往往低于从文本回答，即使语音内容与文本提示完全一致。现有分析通过表征的几何结构来研究这种模态差距，并衡量语音表征与文本表征的接近程度。几何对齐使这一差距具有可测量的形式，但它并未表明模型是否以相同方式使用已对齐的表征。本工作将表征几何与答案形成过程联系起来，探究几何对齐是否意味着功能等价。我们在 SpeechMMLU 和 VoiceBench BBH 上，对四个开源权重语音大语言模型比较了跨层中心化核对齐（CKA）与逐层答案裕度。在 Qwen2.5-Omni 和 MiniCPM-o 中，语音与文本表征在中间层实现对齐，但它们的后期层答案裕度仍然不同，因此中间层的对齐并不意味着功能等价。
tldr: 该研究通过对比跨层CKA表征对齐与逐层答案裕度，发现语音大语言模型中语音与文本表征在中间层虽实现几何对齐，但后期层答案形成方式仍存在差异，证明几何对齐并不等于功能等价。
en_tdlr: This study compares cross-layer CKA alignment with layer-wise answer margins in speech LLMs, showing that speech and text representations align geometrically in middle layers but still differ in late-layer answer formation, demonstrating that geometric alignment does not imply functional equivalence.
